search_recheck.finding: The official NBSDC record exposes a concrete 2022 station-operation dataset with a CC0 1.0 badge, a two-file package and an entity-file folder containing 固定站运营数据.xlsx; the actual file download is gated behind NBSDC registration/login, so the synchronized archive, channel dictionary and common-clock pairing remain unverified.
search_recheck.action: Do not admit any NBSDC lead to the external holdout gate until the exact downloadable archive is obtained under the stated CC0 terms (or access is attested), its checksum and channel dictionary are recorded, common-clock station/dispenser/receiving-vessel linkage is verified, and the model/split are frozen before reading numerical rows.

purpose: Record public leads that may contain synchronized HRS-to-vehicle measurements without admitting unverified material as validation evidence.

accepted_candidate_requirements: publicly identifiable source and persistent identifier
raw or de-identified common-clock station/dispenser/receiving-vessel channels
access and reuse terms suitable for independent scoring
not_admitted_as_validation: aggregate station inventories or pass/fail tables
article claims without a reproducible data file
data whose license or channel provenance is unresolved

candidates.title: 35/70MPa fixed hydrogenation-station demonstration operation dataset
reported_measurements: fixed 35/70 MPa station monitoring during fuel-cell-vehicle refueling
station-operation telemetry described by the official record
candidates.raw_data_status: official page lists a two-file package (436.08KB) and an entity folder containing 固定站运营数据.xlsx; opening the file currently requires NBSDC registration/login
candidates.channel_dictionary_status: dataset-description document is listed; machine-readable channel names, units, common clock and vehicle/event linkage not yet independently extracted
candidates.license_status: official page displays CC0 1.0; archive access and checksum still require an authenticated download, so independent-scoring provenance is pending
candidates.next_action: Obtain the public archive through an authorized NBSDC account or custodian attestation, record SHA-256 and the data-description file, then verify station/dispenser/vehicle boundary, units, clock and event linkage before a frozen external score.
candidates.claim_boundary: The official record establishes a strong, concrete station-operation lead and an explicit CC0 badge. Because the raw workbook is login-gated and its channels have not been independently verified, it is not yet a reproducible full-loop external holdout and has not been used for fitting or scoring.

decision.reason: The official NBSDC 35/70MPa record is a stronger concrete lead than the prior landing-only references, but its raw workbook is login-gated and no independent channel/clock/pairing verification has been completed. No newly found candidate is therefore admitted as an external holdout.
decision.minimum_next_input: Use the privacy-safe three-event intake contract rather than publishing confidential raw logs.
